INQUIRE.gloss: address a question to and expect an answer from
INQUIRE.definition: Address a question to and expect an answer from.

URINE.example: There was blood in his urine.

QUIRE.definition: A quantity of paper; 24 or 25 sheets.

RUIN.gloss: an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction
RUIN.definition: An irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction.
RUIN.example: You have brought ruin on this entire family.

RUNE.gloss: any character from an ancient Germanic alphabet used in Scandinavia from the 3rd…
RUNE.definition: Any character from an ancient Germanic alphabet used in Scandinavia from the 3rd century to the Middle Ages.
RUNE.example: Each rune had its own magical significance.

RUN.gloss: move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
RUN.definition: Move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time.
RUN.example: Don't run--you'll be out of breath.

REIN.gloss: one of a pair of long straps used to control a horse
REIN.definition: One of a pair of long straps (usually connected to the bit or the headpiece) used to control a horse.
